known_script:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
Write-Host "HOSTNAME=$(hostname)"
Write-Host "USER=$env:USERDOMAIN\$env:USERNAME"
Write-Host "OS=$((Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).Caption) $((Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).Version)"
Write-Host "--- Python ---"
where.exe python 2>$null
Write-Host "--- Vivado ---"
where.exe vivado 2>$null
Write-Host "--- Xilinx/Digilent USB ---"
Get-PnpDevice | Where-Object { $_.FriendlyName -match 'Xilinx|Digilent|JTAG|USB.*Serial|FTDI' -or $_.InstanceId -match '0403|1443|03FD' } | Format-Table -AutoSize Status,Class,FriendlyName,InstanceId
Write-Host "--- PCIe/XDMA candidates ---"
Get-PnpDevice | Where-Object { $_.FriendlyName -match 'Xilinx|XDMA|FPGA|PCI Express|DMA' -or $_.InstanceId -match 'VEN_10EE|10EE' } | Format-Table -AutoSize Status,Class,FriendlyName,InstanceId
Write-Host "--- XDMA files/dirs quick search ---"
Get-ChildItem C:\,D:\,E:\ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'Xilinx|XDMA|Workspace|PCIE|Vivado' } | Format-Table -AutoSize FullName,Mode

[Version]
CatalogFile               = XDMA.cat
Class                     = %ClassName% ;TODO use a different class - maybe "Memory Technology device" or "MultiFunction device"
ClassGuid                 = {a3a4c1ce-5a80-452c-9b51-a98edd3378d1}
DriverPackageDisplayName  = %XDMA.DRVDESC%
DriverPackageType         = PlugAndPlay
DriverVer = 06/12/2026,11.38.8.505
Provider                  = %Companyname%
Signature                 = "$WINDOWS NT$"

[DestinationDirs]
DefaultDestDir  = 12
CoInstaller_CopyFiles = 11

; ====================== Class Section ========================================
[ClassInstall32]
Addreg		= XDMA.ClassReg

[XDMA.ClassReg]
HKR,,,0,%ClassName%
HKR,,Icon,,-5
HKR,,DeviceCharacteristics,0x10001,0x100     ;Use same security checks on relative opens
HKR,,Security,,"D:P(A;;GA;;;SY)(A;;GA;;;BA)(A;;GRGW;;;WD)" ;Allow generic all access to system, built-in Admin and World

; ====================== Device Install Section ===============================
[ControlFlags]
ExcludeFromSelect = *

[Manufacturer]
%Companyname%=Xilinx,NTamd64

[SourceDisksFiles]
XDMA.sys    = 1
;


[SourceDisksNames]
1="XDMA Install Disk",

; For XP and later
[Xilinx.NTamd64]
; DisplayName           Section			DeviceId
; -----------           -------			--------
%XDMA.DRVDESC%=			XDMA_Inst,		PCI\VEN_10ee&DEV_9011

[XDMA_Inst.NT]
CopyFiles   =	XDMA.CopyFiles

[XDMA.CopyFiles]
XDMA.sys

; MSI/MSI-X support
[XDMA_Inst.NT.HW]
AddReg = XDMA.EnableMSI

; DEV_9018 /tmp bitstream profile: 1 user IRQ, 1 H2C, 1 C2H, single MSI vector.
[XDMA.EnableMSI]
HKR,"Interrupt Management",,0x00000010
HKR,"Interrupt Management\MessageSignaledInterruptProperties",,0x00000010
HKR,"Interrupt Management\MessageSignaledInterruptProperties",MSISupported,0x00010001,1
HKR,"Interrupt Management\MessageSignaledInterruptProperties",MessageNumberLimit,0x00010001,1


[XDMA_Inst.NT.Services]
AddService     = XDMA,0x00000002,XDMA_Service

[XDMA_Service]
DisplayName    = %XDMA.SVCDESC%
ServiceType    = 1                  ; SERVICE_KERNEL_DRIVER
StartType      = 3                  ; SERVICE_DEMAND_START
ErrorControl   = 1                  ; SERVICE_ERROR_NORMAL
ServiceBinary  = %12%\XDMA.sys
AddReg         = XDMA_Inst.NT.Services.AddReg  ;Commented out for installer use, For debug include in build

[XDMA_Inst.NT.Services.AddReg]
HKR,Parameters,"POLL_MODE",0x00010001,1 ; set to 1 for hardware polling, default is 0 (interrupts)
HKR,Parameters,"USER_IRQ_MAX",0x00010001,1
HKR,Parameters,"H2C_CHANNEL_MAX",0x00010001,1
HKR,Parameters,"C2H_CHANNEL_MAX",0x00010001,1


; ====================== WDF Coinstaller installation =========================

[XDMA_Inst.NT.CoInstallers]
AddReg         = CoInstaller_AddReg
CopyFiles      = CoInstaller_CopyFiles

[CoInstaller_AddReg]
;


[CoInstaller_CopyFiles]
;


[XDMA_Inst.NT.Wdf]
KmdfService    = XDMA, XDMA_wdfsect

[XDMA_wdfsect]
KmdfLibraryVersion = 1.15

;======================= String Definitions ===================================
[Strings]
Companyname				= "Xilinx"
ClassName				= "Xilinx Drivers"
XDMA.SVCDESC			= "Xilinx DMA Driver Service"
XDMA.DRVDESC			= "Xilinx DMA"
DeviceDescription		= "Xilinx FPGA device"
